-- Prueft die endgueltige Kopfregel und die Termindubletten. Nur lesend.
WITH pos AS (
    SELECT
        p.booking_id,
        coalesce(nullif(btrim(p.pricecategory_name), ''), '(ohne namen)') AS kat,
        coalesce(p.quantity, 0) AS menge,
        coalesce(p.amount_net, 0) AS betrag,
        CASE
            WHEN p.pricecategory_name ~* '(bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}[0-9]+[[:space:]]*person'
            THEN (substring(p.pricecategory_name from '(?i)(?:bis zu|max\\.?|fuer|für)[^0-9]{0,12}([0-9]+)[[:space:]]*person'))::int
        END AS basis_n,
        (p.pricecategory_name ~* '(jede|je|pro)[[:space:]]+weitere|preis[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*für[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*jede[^a-zA-ZäöüÄÖÜß]*weitere') AS ist_zusatz
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking_position p
),
je_buchung AS (
    SELECT
        b.booking_id,
        b.offer_id,
        s.status,
        coalesce(s.netto, 0) AS netto,
        max(pos.basis_n) AS basis_n,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.ist_zusatz), 0) AS zusatz_n,
        bool_or(pos.kat = 'Inklusive') AS hat_inklusive,
        coalesce(sum(pos.menge) FILTER (WHERE pos.kat = 'Inklusive'), 0) AS inklusive_n,
        sum(pos.menge) AS menge_alt,
        string_agg(concat(left(pos.kat, 35), ' x', pos.menge), ' + ' ORDER BY pos.betrag DESC, pos.kat) AS zeilen_text
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_buchung_steuer s ON s.booking_id = b.booking_id
    JOIN pos ON pos.booking_id = b.booking_id
    GROUP BY b.booking_id, b.offer_id, s.status, 4
),
mit_plaetzen AS (
    SELECT j.*,
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN basis_n + zusatz_n
               WHEN hat_inklusive THEN NULL
               ELSE 1
           END AS plaetze,
           CASE
               WHEN basis_n IS NOT NULL THEN 'paket sicher'
               WHEN hat_inklusive THEN 'paket basis unklar'
               ELSE 'einzelbuchung'
           END AS regel
    FROM je_buchung j
),
je_termin AS (
    SELECT
        o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht') AS buchungen,
        count(*) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht' AND m.plaetze IS NULL) AS unklare_buchungen,
        coalesce(sum(m.plaetze) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0) AS plaetze_sicher,
        round(coalesce(sum(m.netto) FILTER (WHERE m.status = 'gebucht'), 0), 2) AS netto
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer o
    JOIN mit_plaetzen m ON m.offer_id = o.offer_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    GROUP BY o.offer_id, o.offer_number, o.name, o.date_start, o.user_maximum
),
dublettenschluessel AS (
    SELECT name, date_start
    FROM edoobox_raw.offer
    WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND date_start IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY name, date_start
    HAVING count(*) > 1
),
roh AS (
    SELECT 10 AS ordnung, 'A Regelabdeckung' AS bereich,
           regel AS kennzahl, count(*)::numeric AS wert,
           concat('netto ', round(sum(netto), 2),
                  ' / inklusive-menge ', sum(inklusive_n),
                  ' / alte mengensumme ', sum(menge_alt)) AS hinweis
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 20, 'B Sichere Paketgroesse',
           concat(plaetze, ' plaetze'), count(*)::numeric,
           concat('basis im schnitt ', round(avg(basis_n), 2),
                  ' / zusatz im schnitt ', round(avg(zusatz_n), 2),
                  ' / netto ', round(sum(netto), 2))
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND regel = 'paket sicher'
    GROUP BY 3

    UNION ALL SELECT 30, 'C Ueberbuchung sicher',
           concat(to_char(t.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(t.name, 36)),
           t.plaetze_sicher::numeric,
           concat('hoechstzahl ', t.user_maximum,
                  ' / buchungen ', t.buchungen,
                  ' / unklar ', t.unklare_buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', t.netto)
    FROM je_termin t
    WHERE t.user_maximum > 0
      AND t.unklare_buchungen = 0
      AND t.plaetze_sicher > t.user_maximum

    UNION ALL SELECT 40, 'D Unklare Paketbuchung',
           concat('b', right(booking_id::text, 5)),
           inklusive_n::numeric,
           left(zeilen_text, 170)
    FROM mit_plaetzen
    WHERE status = 'gebucht' AND regel = 'paket basis unklar'

    UNION ALL SELECT 50, 'E Dublettenbelegung',
           concat(to_char(t.date_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), ' ', left(t.name, 30)),
           t.buchungen::numeric,
           concat('nummer ', left(coalesce(t.offer_number, '-'), 35),
                  ' / plaetze sicher ', t.plaetze_sicher,
                  ' / unklar ', t.unklare_buchungen,
                  ' / netto ', t.netto)
    FROM je_termin t
    JOIN dublettenschluessel d ON d.name = t.name AND d.date_start = t.date_start

    UNION ALL SELECT 60, 'F offerdef_ref',
           'verschiedene werte', count(DISTINCT offerdef_ref)::numeric,
           concat('nicht leer ', count(offerdef_ref),
                  ' / termine ', count(*),
                  ' / groesste gruppe ', max(gruppengroesse))
    FROM (
        SELECT offerdef_ref, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY offerdef_ref) AS gruppengroesse
        FROM edoobox_raw.offer
        WHERE is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
    ) x
)
SELECT
    'S37' AS schritt,
    count(*) AS zeilen,
    string_agg(
        concat_ws(' | ', bereich, kennzahl, trim(to_char(wert, '99999999990.99')), coalesce(hinweis, '-')),
        chr(10) ORDER BY ordnung, wert DESC, kennzahl
    ) AS bericht
FROM roh;
